objects.name: Analytic 2129
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux service process initiating an outbound connection on a commonly-used port to a destination not in the approved vendor domain list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): connect() syscall on port (e.g., 80, 443, 8080, etc.) to destination not in approved vendor domains, from Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service process

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of legitimate vendor domains for software updates, licensing, or remote support.
Inventory of ICS hosts whose documented function never requires outbound internet connectivity.
